title: fumaria agraria var. pallescens
intro: Fumaria agraria var. pallescens, commonly known as pale fumitory, is a plant species within the family Fumariaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of pale fumitory include reducing inflammation, pain relief, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of pale fumitory include alkaloids, such as chelidonine and chelerythrine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
